**blast_radius** (function)

**Location:** shipgate/scripts/signals.py:1076
**Signature:** `(graph: Graph, seeds: Sequence[str], limit: int) -> Dict[str, Any]`

Reverse-adjacency BFS from the seeds; cycle-safe; seeds excluded.

```python
1076	def blast_radius(graph: Graph, seeds: Sequence[str], limit: int) -> Dict[str, Any]:
1077	    """Reverse-adjacency BFS from the seeds; cycle-safe; seeds excluded."""
1078	    import posixpath
1079	    from collections import deque
1080	
1081	    seen = set(seeds)
1082	    queue = deque(sorted(seen))
1083	    reached: set = set()
1084	    while queue:
1085	        current = queue.popleft()
1086	        for importer in graph.inn.get(current, ()):
1087	            if importer not in seen:
1088	                seen.add(importer)
1089	                reached.add(importer)
1090	                queue.append(importer)
1091	    files = sorted(reached)
1092	    by_dir = Counter(posixpath.dirname(f) or "." for f in files)
1093	    return {
1094	        "size": len(files),
1095	        "files": files[:limit],
1096	        "truncated": len(files) > limit,
1097	        "by_dir": dict(sorted(by_dir.items())),
1098	        "unknown_seeds": sorted(s for s in set(seeds) if s not in graph.status),
1099	    }
```
